choices.text: Decide on the spot: unload the driver near his hours limit first and tell the other carrier to wait 40 minutes.
Call both carriers' dispatchers, explain the constraint, and let them agree on an order before anything moves.
Hold both trucks until maintenance confirms whether Door 4's seal can be patched safely.

response.text: It is 7:00 at a distribution center off Highway 99 in Stockton. Two refrigerated trucks of table grapes arrive at once, and only Door 6 has a working dock seal. One driver is close to his hours-of-service limit and wants to drop the trailer and go. As the Logistics Operations Lead from Modesto, you need to decide what happens next.
response.title: Two trucks, one door
